This individual translates client objectives into tactical campaign strategies, owns campaign optimization and budget management, identifies opportunities for account growth, and communicates performance insights and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.  What You Should Have   3+ years of professional experience managing digital media campaigns, with significant hands-on experience in paid search.   Strong expertise in Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and paid search campaign management.   Experience managing campaigns end to end, including planning, setup, launch, optimization,
